name: Leantime
description: Leantime is a goals focused project management system for non-project managers.
composeYaml:
services:
  leantime:
    image: 'leantime/leantime:latest'
    environment:
      - 'LEAN_APP_URL=${APP_URL}'
      - LEAN_DB_HOST=mysql
      - 'LEAN_DB_USER=${MYSQLDB_USER}'
      - 'LEAN_DB_PASSWORD=${MYSQLDB_PASSWORD}'
      - 'LEAN_DB_DATABASE=${DB_NAME:-leantime-db}'
      - 'LEAN_SESSION_PASSWORD=${SALT_PASSWORD}'
      - 'LEAN_SESSION_EXPIRATION=${SESSION_EXPIRATION:-28800}'
      - 'LEAN_USE_REDIS=${USE_REDIS:-true}'
      - LEAN_REDIS_HOST=redis
      - 'LEAN_REDIS_PORT=${REDIS_PORT:-6379}'
      - 'LEAN_REDIS_SCHEME=${REDIS_SCHEME:-tcp}'
    depends_on:
      mysql:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_started
    volumes:
      - 'public-userfiles:/var/www/html/public/userfiles'
      - 'userfiles:/var/www/html/userfiles'
      - 'plugins:/var/www/html/app/Plugins'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - '-f'
        - 'http://127.0.0.1:8080'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 10
  mysql:
    image: 'mysql:8.4'
    volumes:
      - 'leantime_mysql_data:/var/lib/mysql'
    environment:
      - 'MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=${MYSQLROOT_PASSWORD}'
      - 'MYSQL_USER=${MYSQLDB_USER}'
      - 'MYSQL_PASSWORD=${MYSQLDB_PASSWORD}'
      - 'MYSQL_DATABASE=${DB_NAME:-leantime-db}'
    command: '--character-set-server=UTF8MB4 --collation-server=UTF8MB4_unicode_ci'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - mysqladmin
        - ping
        - '-h'
        - localhost
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
  redis:
    image: 'redis:7-alpine'
    command: 'redis-server --appendonly yes'
    volumes:
      - 'leantime_redis_data:/data'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - redis-cli
        - ping
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3

meta.about: Lean project management system for small teams and startups helping to manage projects from ideation through delivery.
